items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The other day we met Mr. August Loran. He said he played in, [INTERVIEWEE] and he thought it was Mr. Humphrey's last job.

ctx.x: Well, that's what he's asking. Yes, don't bother you by detail, but just to get a few of those bands that you mentioned is good. Yeah.

Um, I played in 50 different, 50 different bands. I played in Los Angeles and we played Mr. McVeer and played, played banjo, three pieces. I used to do it. We played saxophone band, and band, and bass. The other day we met Mr. August Loran. He said he played in,
and he thought it was Mr. Humphrey's last job.
